name: FirstUse
title: Templates/Platform/States/FirstUse
summary: The block a first-level list renders before the account owns any resource of that kind: a flush Card holding an EmptyState (the resource glyph, headline, lead and a Documentation link) over an Item.List of the ways to create the first one, each led by `Item.Media kind="icon"` (the CLI method copies `azion deploy`), with the promo cards below it, each a link covering its card: Catalog templates (only for resource kinds that have a template catalog) and agent onboarding, whose frames carry the Claude, Codex, Gemini and Cursor marks from the webkit assets. The EmptyState’s icon slot shows the resource glyph; an app may draw a richer figure there. Every list that is still empty renders it with its own nouns, methods and promos. Built from Card, EmptyState, Item, Button, InputGroup, Input, CopyButton and Link. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.
